user.title: IU Irrigation Dashboard
user.description: Sets up the irrigation panel for Irrigation Unlimited. Pumps, valves, zones, sequences and schedules are configured afterwards in the panel under “Settings”. An existing Irrigation Unlimited configuration is imported.

bestand.title: Existing Irrigation Unlimited configuration found
bestand.description: configuration.yaml contains its own “irrigation_unlimited:” section (lines {von}–{bis}). Its controllers, zones, sequences and schedules are imported on first start. From then on the configuration is generated in packages/iu_irrigation_dashboard.yaml, so the section has to go. After setup, check the import in the panel under “Settings”; then Settings → Repairs offers to comment the section out (with a backup).

abort.single_instance_allowed: IU Irrigation Dashboard is already set up.

iu_neustart.title: IU Irrigation Dashboard: restart required
iu_neustart.description: The Irrigation Unlimited configuration was written to {datei}. Irrigation Unlimited loads it only after a restart of Home Assistant.

iu_include.title: IU Irrigation Dashboard: packages folder is not loaded
iu_include.description:
The Irrigation Unlimited configuration is stored in {datei}. To load it, configuration.yaml must include the packages/ folder:

```yaml
homeassistant:
  packages: !include_dir_named packages
```

Then restart Home Assistant.

iu_konflikt.title: IU Irrigation Dashboard: duplicate Irrigation Unlimited configuration
iu_konflikt.description: configuration.yaml still contains its own “irrigation_unlimited:” section (lines {von}–{bis}). IU Irrigation Dashboard now generates the configuration in {datei} and does not reload Irrigation Unlimited while both exist. The settings were imported from the section on first start – check them in the panel, then click “Submit” to comment the section out.

confirm.title: Comment out the irrigation_unlimited section
confirm.description:
These lines {von}–{bis} of configuration.yaml are prefixed with “#”:

```
{auszug}
```

A copy of the file is saved first as configuration.yaml.iu_backup_<date>. The rest of the file stays unchanged. Irrigation Unlimited is then reloaded with {datei}; if it is not loaded yet, a restart is requested.

abort.geaendert: configuration.yaml has changed in the meantime. Nothing was modified – please open the repair again.
abort.nicht_gefunden: configuration.yaml no longer contains an “irrigation_unlimited:” section.
